Anya: Tiny commute swap: one song under 4:00 + one single-episode or short essay (<=30min). No novels. I'll start.
Anya: Song – 'Sufjan Stevens - Should Have Known Better' (3:52). Short – 'On Wanting to Be Someone Else' (essay, ~20min). :train:
Raj: Love that essay. Mine: Song – 'Arctic Monkeys - No. 1 Party Anthem' (3:06). Short – 'Charlie Brooker: Screen Time' (15min segment).
Marta: I pick something cozy: Song – 'Nick Drake - Place To Be' (3:05). Short – 'The Emperor's New Clothes' animated short (12min) 1 classic retelling.
Tom: Going upbeat: Song – 'Phoenix - Lizstomania' (3:51). Short – 'Black Mirror: San Junipero' is longer so not allowed, but the Yasmin Sequel mini-doc (25min) is great.
Anya: Anyone want to assemble a 6-track "pocket commute" playlist? I can add and share.
Raj: I'll add mine. Quick poll: react :one: if you prefer mellow, :two: for upbeat, :three: for eclectic. I'll tally lunchtime.
snack-bot: Reminder: Free granola bars in kitchen today. Fuel your listening. :bar_chart:
Marta: Results at noon: :one: 4 :two: 2 :three: 1 1 mellow wins. Playlist link (placeholder): https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0pocketCommuteExample
Tom: Nice. If anyone has short essays in PDF, drop in /shared/reading/pocket/ and I'll make a tiny index.
Anya: Perfect. Mellow commute hour next Tuesday, headphones optional. :headphones:
